proc_p: A walk-in wardrobe usually takes four to six weeks to make after you approve the design.
steps: We measure the room and go through what you own: long hanging, short hanging, shoes, bags and drawers.
You walk through the room in 3D before anything is made, with a quote that lists every section.
Every section is made to your room in our workshop, including any lighting runs.
We fit the whole room and finish it to the walls, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Tell us about the room and what you want to keep in it. We’ll visit, measure up and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
